title: Location Payload v1
description: payload for an envelope with eventType='location', schemaVersion=1. A single GPS fix.

speedKmh.description: Ground speed in km/h, if the device reports it.

headingDeg.description: Heading in degrees clockwise from true north [0, 360).

accuracyM.description: Horizontal accuracy radius in metres, if reported. Honored by ingest plausibility checks.
